## Medical Specialties (التخصصات الطبية)

Dr. Mohamed Kamal Ali specializes in 16 orthopedic subspecialties:

### Limb Reconstruction & Deformity Correction (إعادة بناء الأطراف وتصحيح التشوهات)
1. **External Fixators & Limb Reconstruction** — Ilizarov frames and circular fixators for complex bone reconstruction
2. **Hexapod Deformity Correction** — Taylor Spatial Frame (TSF) for multi-planar deformity correction
3. **Cosmetic Limb Lengthening** — Surgical limb lengthening for height enhancement and symmetry
4. **Bow-Legs & Knock-Knees (Varus/Valgus)** — Correction of angular lower limb deformities
5. **Non-Union & Malunion Fractures** — Treatment of fractures that failed to heal properly

### Joints (المفاصل)
6. **Knee Replacement** — Total and partial knee arthroplasty
7. **Hip Replacement** — Total hip arthroplasty for arthritis and hip disorders
8. **Knee Arthroscopy** — Minimally invasive knee surgery
9. **Ankle Arthroscopy** — Minimally invasive ankle joint surgery
10. **ACL & Ligament Reconstruction** — Anterior cruciate ligament repair and reconstruction

### Trauma & Fractures (الإصابات والكسور)
11. **Complex Fracture Fixation** — Advanced internal and external fixation techniques
12. **Sports Injuries** — Diagnosis and surgical treatment of sports-related injuries

### Upper & Lower Extremities (الأطراف)
13. **Foot & Ankle Disorders** — Surgical correction of foot deformities and ankle conditions
14. **Shoulder & Elbow Surgery** — Shoulder instability, rotator cuff, and elbow disorders
15. **Pediatric Orthopedics** — Bone and joint disorders in children and adolescents
16. **Bone Tumors & Cysts** — Surgical management of benign bone tumors and cysts

## Qualifications & Credentials (المؤهلات العلمية)

- **MBBCh** — Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery, Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt
- **MSc** — Master of Science in Orthopedic Surgery, Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt
- **MD (Doctorate)** — Doctoral Thesis in Orthopedic Surgery, Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt
- **Fellowship** — Orthopedic Surgery Fellowship, University of Düsseldorf, Germany
- **EBOT** — European Board of Orthopaedics and Traumatology (EBOT) — 2012
- **FRCSI** — Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland

## Career Timeline (المسيرة المهنية)

| Year | Position | Location |
|------|----------|----------|
| 1996–2001 | Orthopedic Registrar | Ain Shams University Hospitals, Cairo, Egypt |
| 2001–2004 | Orthopedic Fellow | University of Düsseldorf, Germany |
| 2004–2008 | Orthopedic Specialist | King Fahd Hospital, Saudi Arabia |
| 2008–2012 | Orthopedic Consultant | Khawla Hospital (Limb Reconstruction Unit), Muscat, Oman |
| 2012–2015 | Visiting Professor of Orthopedics | Gulf Medical University, Ajman, UAE |
| 2015–2018 | Medical Director | Amina Hospital, Ajman, UAE |
| 2018–2021 | Senior Consultant | Various UAE Medical Centers |
| 2021–present | Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon | Dar Al Kamal Hospital, Sharjah & Medical Treatment Center (Elaj), Ajman, UAE |

- **Total Experience:** 25+ years in orthopedic surgery
- **Operations Performed:** 500+ successful limb reconstruction and lengthening surgeries

## Medical Philosophy (الفلسفة الطبية)

Dr. Mohamed Kamal Ali believes that:
- Preserving movement begins with understanding the problem
- The correct treatment decision is based on medical knowledge, surgical expertise, and precise assessment
- Treatment selection is not based on imaging results alone but on clinical examination, symptom nature, and patient goals
- Every case is unique and requires individualized analysis — especially in limb reconstruction, deformity correction, and joint replacement
